decisions: Polynesian Coast founds in Sparse Jungle, taken from Jungle (which keeps Jungle and Bamboo Jungle), and on beaches beside warm or lukewarm ocean; Nautical Coast keeps temperate and cold coasts (Aaron, 2026-09-12).
The two Polynesian farms are this catalog's farm tiers; the Floodplain catalog keeps its own copies of them.

identity.palette: Polynesian roofs use oak (slabs and stairs) and the sides use stripped spruce wood; restyled donors follow the same logic.
identity.villageBanners: PC01.1 carries three village banners: two outside and one inside. Every other banner in the selected pieces, including the white banners in PC02.5 and PC02.8, is decoration and stays white. The PC11 gatehouse banners are village banners.
identity.beds: Beds alternate between the village primary and secondary colors; a couple bed is one unit and takes one color. This includes the tavern's beds.

openChoices.biome: Decided 2026-09-12: Polynesian Coast founds in Sparse Jungle (taken from Jungle, which keeps Jungle and Bamboo Jungle) and on beaches beside warm or lukewarm ocean; Nautical Coast keeps temperate and cold coasts. Needs the jungle style tag and a warm-beach site check at integration.
openChoices.centerPosts: The quartermaster (routed to the storehouse), builder, guard captain and miner (routed to the mine) stand in the forecourt by the bell.

codeNotes: Castle amenities are allowed on a castle or a village centre (CastleLayout.allowedIn); custody accepts the centre.
The ruling incumbent is the LEADER at a castle or at the centre (VillageRuler).
A centre with a jail is not a castle for guard duty or for CastleLayout.canStart.
The king sleeps in any bed; the rule that a bed is reserved only inside the employing building stays.
Sparse Jungle moved from the Jungle style tag to Polynesian Coast; a beach within 48 blocks of kithkyn:warm_ocean selects Polynesian Coast.
Block-by-block construction places lily pads, sugar cane and frogspawn after the liquids they stand on.

review.authoredGeometry: Gallery pieces were placed as sourced. Three donors were restyled in place to oak roofs over stripped spruce (restyles on PC04.4, PC06.1 and PC05.3), the workshop rows swap materials on the bundled Birch geometry (swaps), and Aaron's live edits are captured by the catalog, not here.
review.fluidContainment: Pieces holding water or waterlogged blocks stand inside a one-block barrier ring two cells out, placed before the template; the sunk jungle well stands on a floor one block below its shaft.

standIns.rule: CTOV compatibility work blocks from mods the server lacks are replaced by vanilla stand-ins in the private display copies only; the source hashes and templates are untouched.

review.visualMethod: Offline render of the saved trio world's region files: a top-down map and a front elevation of every row. A windowed capture client received a macOS Quit AppleEvent within seconds of opening on three attempts, so no in-game screenshots were taken.

footprintCheck.rule: non-air blocks in each placed footprint of the saved world against the prepared template
footprintCheck.deviationCause: Extra cells are structure-void markers left by jigsaw final states. CTOV compatibility work blocks from mods the server lacks are replaced by vanilla stand-ins (standIns), so no block is missing.

forceloadsAfter: No force loaded chunks were found in Overworld
